title: The Candle on the Table
lines: Meg has a little candle on the table.
It sits next to a bottle and an apple.
Meg picks up the bottle by its handle.
The handle slips and the bottle bumps the candle.
The candle falls and rolls behind a big box.
Meg gets flat on the rug and pokes it.
It is stuck. She can not get it.
Then Meg thinks of the handle on the box.
Mom holds the box still as Meg tips it.
The candle rolls back into Meg's hand.
That was a simple fix, and Meg grins.

questions.ask: What made the candle fall off the table?
questions.listenFor: The handle slipped, so the bottle bumped the candle. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: How did Meg get the candle out from behind the box?
questions.listenFor: She tipped the box by its handle while Mom held it still. If they say "she poked it," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: Do you think Meg will keep the candle on the table? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story.
